loop_tag.description: Tag ID or unique name to wrap onion frames within.
loop_tag.title: Loop Tag

frames.description: Frame selection: zero-based index, index list, all, range 0-3, or tag:name.
frames.title: Frames

tileset.description: Tileset ID or unique name; render its labeled tile grid.
tileset.title: Tileset

layout.description: Separate images (at most 8), one strip, or one frame grid.
layout.title: Layout

layers.description: Layer references to include; omission uses the operation default selection.
layers.title: Layers

scale.description: Integer nearest-neighbor scale; auto fits previews within their size limit.
scale.title: Scale

grid.description: Overlay the stored integer document grid.
grid.title: Grid

rulers.description: Add integer coordinate rulers to the diagnostic preview.
rulers.title: Rulers

onion.description: Number of previous and next frames to include as onion skins (0-8 each).

background.description: Checker, palette index/exact color, or raw #rrggbb decoration.
background.title: Background

inline.description: Include base64 PNG data for clients that display inline images.
inline.title: Inline
